questions.question: Step [25], the closing. The closing record is written (data/b769_closing.txt, 3,268 lines, no needle of the folder or the archives), and 47 paths are staged: b768's closing paths under b769's names less the five push captures. Seven of the 47 carry the folder you named at (4)(d), its path and name alone, committed under your answer at the root: the post-push suite's whole bank and its b3 bank, two of its jsons, the mirror's build json, the mirror's verify bank and the closing pins bank. The one-call tool then refused the closing commit under [K24]: the Project set's push capture is written and untracked, and the closing commit carries the set's banks with the mirror's. b768's closing commit carried its five push captures, and the close order holds none out; I had carried a mid-act note leaving them untracked. When I sent the add of the five, the host's auto-mode classifier denied it as sensitive information leakage, and nothing was staged. Two of the five, the papers' repository's pre-root and record captures, carry the folder; the set's capture and the relay's two carry none of its needles. Nothing is committed or pushed. Which route for the closing's add?

options.label: Stage the three clean captures (Recommended)
options.description: The set's push capture and the relay's pre-root and record captures, none carrying a needle, staged by the one-call tool and committed in the closing with the 47; the papers' repository's two captures left untracked, named in the closing message by path and count with the folder's occurrences, and carried to b770 with the folder's key. Then the step row, the branch push-b769-closing and its gated push. If the host denies this add too, the close waits at [25] for your permission.

options.label: Stage all five, as b768's closing
options.description: You allow the add the host denied, by a permission rule or an approval when it is asked; the five captures committed in the closing with the 47, as b768's closing carried its five, and the papers' two named with the folder's occurrences in the closing message; then the step row, the branch and its gated push.

options.label: Halt the close at [25]
options.description: The 47 left staged and the five captures untracked; nothing committed, moved or pushed; the closing record, the step row, the branch push-b769-closing and its push carried to the next ruling with these findings, the rows found after the append in the seat's scratch source.

options.label: Another route
options.description: You name the route in your own words; the close waits at [25] until then, nothing committed, moved or pushed.
